item.title: KENNY SEALS LOAN DEAL
item.description: JOHNNY KENNY has swapped chasing the Premiership title with Celtic for aiming at promotion at Bolton. The Republic of Ireland striker has sealed a loan exit from the champions to join the English League One club until the end of the season. There had also been interest in Kenny from German side Schalke, but the [...]

item.title: ‘HONOURED,’ SAYS NEW BHOY ARTHUR
item.description: BENJAMIN ARTHUR became the FOURTH player to join Celtic on loan in this window when he agreed a temporary move from Brentford. The 20-year-old central defender has been brought in as cover with Cameron Carter-Vickers almost certainly out for the remainder of the season. Martin O’Neill needed reinforcements in the middle of the rearguard and [...]

item.title: ‘WOW’, NEW BHOY JOEL’S REACTION TO CELTIC FANS
item.description: VERSATILE winger Joel Mvuka was a third beat-the-clock signing for Celtic on deadline day when he arrived from French outfit Lorient. The 22-year-old winger has agreed a loan deal until the end of the season with the Hoops having an option to buy. Mvuka hopes to hit all the right notes with the champions’ support [...]

item.title: EX-GER COULD SCUPPER CELTIC MOVE FOR £35m MAN
item.description: CELTIC’S reported interest in former £35million man Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain could be scuppered – by a former Rangers player! The 32-year-old ex-Arsenal and Liverpool midfielder is available after being released by Besiktas in August last year. item.title: CELTIC: INS AND OUTS
item.description: CELTIC have agreed a £435,000 loan fee for striker Junior Adamu from Bundesliga outfit SC Freiburg. There is also a £4.3million option to make the transfer permanent, according to Sky Sports. item.title: Martin and Shaun play their cards
item.description: On Sunday we saw the value of our two January signings: Julian Araujo won Man of the Match, while Tomas Cvancara scored the opening goal. item.title: TOBI OR NOT TOBI? KEEPER FINALLY QUITS CELTIC
item.description: TOBI OLUWAYEMI has finally quit Celtic on a permanent deadline-day deal to sign for Leyton Orient. The London-born keeper, so highly rated by ex-boss Ange Postecoglou, has been out on loan to Cork City, Wacker Innsbruck, Dunfermline and Kilmarnock in recent seasons. item.title: OXLADE-CHAMBERLAIN: ‘I’D BE VERY INTERESTED,’ ADMITS O’NEILL
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL revealed he has held talks with free agent Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain. item.title: CELTIC ALERT AS HEARTS LOSE
item.description: CELTIC can cut Hearts’ advantage at the Premiership pinnacle to three points after the Edinburgh side’s 1-0 loss to St Mirren in Paisley this evening.
